# pidginhost_firewall_rule (Resource)

A rule in a `pidginhost_firewall_rules_set`. Every field except `rules_set_id` can be changed in place.

The API validates rules after saving them. If it flags a rule as invalid (`has_error`), apply fails with the API's `error_message`, so a broken firewall never goes unnoticed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_firewall_rules_set" "web" {
  name = "web"
}

resource "pidginhost_firewall_rule" "ssh_from_office" {
  rules_set_id     = pidginhost_firewall_rules_set.web.id
  direction        = "in"
  action           = "ACCEPT"
  protocol         = "tcp"
  source           = "198.51.100.0/24"
  destination_port = "22"
}

resource "pidginhost_firewall_rule" "https" {
  rules_set_id     = pidginhost_firewall_rules_set.web.id
  direction        = "in"
  action           = "ACCEPT"
  protocol         = "tcp"
  destination_port = "80,443"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) `ACCEPT`, `DROP` or `REJECT`.
- `direction` (String) `in` or `out`.
- `rules_set_id` (String) ID of the rule set. Changing it moves the rule by recreating it in the new set.

### Optional

- `destination` (String) Destination address. Single IP, range (`20.34.101.207-201.3.9.99`) or comma-separated list. Empty means any.
- `destination_port` (String) Destination port. Port number (0-65535), range (`80:85`) or comma-separated list. Empty means any. Requires `protocol`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `position` (Number) Position of the rule in the set (0-32767). When omitted, the API assigns one.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol, for example `tcp` or `udp`. Empty means any.
- `source` (String) Source address. Single IP, range (`20.34.101.207-201.3.9.99`) or comma-separated list. Empty means any.
- `source_port` (String) Source port. Port number (0-65535), range (`80:85`) or comma-separated list. Empty means any. Requires `protocol`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `error_message` (String) The API's validation message when `has_error` is true.
- `has_error` (Boolean) Whether the API flagged the rule as invalid.
- `id` (String) Rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a firewall rule as <rules_set_id>/<rule_id>.
terraform import pidginhost_firewall_rule.https 123/456
```
